title: THE ROOT OF A LONG, SATISFIED LIFE
hookText: You can do everything right and still miss loving God
openLoop: Why loving God — not just serving Him — is the real secret

outro.next: Still Standing at 85 — Live by Faith
outro.label: Next episode

recap.title: Love Him with all your heart
items: You can love the work of God and still not love God
He wants your whole heart — not bits and pieces
A divided heart always drifts — come home to Him
Put Him above everything and everyone you love
He loved you first — love is simply your response
